title: Dental benefits
summary: Describes UnitedHealthcare employer dental plan options, benefits, teledentistry and pop-up clinics, with a comparison of plan types.

atoms.title: Dental coverage may help lower medical costs
atoms.question: Why offer a dental plan alongside medical coverage?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare says that because improving oral health may impact overall health, a dental plan may help lower employers' medical costs as well. Employers of all sizes can choose from a variety of dental plan designs, bundled with a UnitedHealthcare medical plan or standalone.
questions: Can dental coverage lower medical costs?
Can an employer buy dental separately from medical?

atoms.title: Dental plan design choices
atoms.question: What dental plan types does UnitedHealthcare offer employers?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare offers dental plan designs including PPO, Exclusive Network and Value plans. They can be bundled with a UnitedHealthcare medical plan or purchased standalone, and are available to employers of all sizes.
questions: What types of dental plans can an employer choose?
Does UnitedHealthcare have a PPO dental plan for employers?

atoms.title: Preventive care and pregnancy dental benefits
atoms.question: What oral health benefits do UnitedHealthcare dental plans include?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare dental benefits include 100% coverage for preventive care, plus additional cleanings and nonsurgical gum treatments during and 3 months after pregnancy. Integrated health management strategies are designed to help employees return to preventive or periodontal care. The page notes this applies when preventive or periodontal care is completed after contact from UnitedHealthcare.
questions: Are extra dental cleanings covered during pregnancy?
Is preventive dental care covered at 100%?

atoms.title: Provider choice and teledentistry access
atoms.question: What dental provider network do employees get?
atoms.text: Employees can choose from a national, quality provider network designed to meet their care needs, including general and pediatric dentistry, orthodontia, periodontal, endodontic or oral surgery. It also includes 24/7 teledentistry for urgent needs.
questions: Does UnitedHealthcare dental include orthodontia providers?

atoms.title: Digital Dental Assistant app
atoms.question: What does the UnitedHealthcare Digital Dental Assistant app do?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare's Digital Dental Assistant app is part of its digital dental support for employer groups. The app helps make it easier for employees to find a dentist, schedule appointment reminders, get health tips and more.
questions: How do I find a dentist with UnitedHealthcare dental?
Is there an app for UnitedHealthcare dental plans?

atoms.title: Jet Dental pop-up clinics and DialCare
atoms.question: What are Jet Dental pop-up clinics and DialCare teledentistry?
atoms.text: Jet Dental provides onsite cleanings and exams at an employer's worksite through pop-up clinics. DialCare teledentistry provides 24/7 advice, follow-up care, second opinion and prescription services when medically necessary. UnitedHealthcare says these services help make it easier for employees to get dental care anytime, anywhere.
questions: Can dental cleanings happen at the workplace?

atoms.title: PPO/open access vs In-Network Only dental
atoms.question: How do UnitedHealthcare PPO/open access and In-Network Only dental plans differ?
atoms.text: PPO/open access plans are available nationally for fully insured groups of 2 or more, with self-funded options for larger groups, a national network with a 38% average network discount, 100% in-network preventive care and out-of-network coverage available. In-Network Only plans (31 states) offer a 36% average network discount and in-network coverage only. Neither requires a primary care dentist or specialist referral.
questions: What is the network discount on a UnitedHealthcare dental PPO?
Does an in-network only dental plan cover out-of-network care?

atoms.title: Exclusive Network dental plans
atoms.question: What are UnitedHealthcare Exclusive Network dental plans?
atoms.text: Exclusive Network plans are available in 9 states for fully insured groups of 2 or more. They are for employers who want to simplify the dental care experience with the benefits of a DHMO plan but without the typical pain points. They offer 100% in-network preventive care, in-network coverage only, no deductible, no annual maximum and no waiting periods.
questions: Do any dental plans have no annual maximum?
What is an Exclusive Network dental plan?

atoms.title: Value dental plans and discounts
atoms.question: What is a UnitedHealthcare Value dental plan?
atoms.text: Value dental plans are available in 19 states and offer a national network with a 34% average network discount. They include 100% preventive care and diagnostics in network, and out-of-network coverage is available. Discounts of 20% to 50% apply to services such as fillings, crowns, whitening and orthodontia; the page notes these discounts are not insurance and members pay for services directly.
questions: Are Value dental plan discounts insurance?
What discounts does a UnitedHealthcare Value dental plan give?
